title: Hand Paint
description: Hand paint, the hand paint look, is wet strokes laid over a living picture, a painter's wrist still in the shot or at least a stroke that just happened. Canvas is finished oil; this is paint as a verb.

sections.title: Narrative function

blocks.text: Making, memory, a portrait being invented: photographic underlayer, color still moving, face kept. A finished gallery still wants canvas.
A dry painterly grade is a lie about process. It is the wrong tool when the paint is dry and even, and the wrong tool if the face dissolves into abstract.
Show wetness and the direction of a stroke that just happened.

sections.title: How it works

blocks.text: Portrait distance, 50mm, lock-off. Photographic underlayer, wet strokes with direction, brush or hand optional in frame.
Color that is still moving. Prompt: Hand-paint over [Subject], wet strokes still moving, a painter's wrist in the picture.

sections.title: What usually goes wrong

blocks.text: A dry painterly grade, or a finished Canvas with no wet act. The tell is no wetness and no stroke direction.
Fix it: wet paint, a stroke that just happened, face held.

sections.title: Questions

blocks.text: What is Hand Paint in film?
Process as image: wet strokes over a living picture, a painter's wrist implied or shown. Paint as a verb, not a finished canvas.
Hand Paint vs Canvas
Canvas is finished oil. Hand paint is the wet act. If the stroke is still moving, you are here. If the gallery object is done, you wanted canvas.
When should I use Hand Paint?
Making, memory, a portrait being invented. Skip dry grades and finished gallery stills.
How do I prompt Hand Paint for AI image or video?
Photographic underlayer, then: Hand-paint over [Subject], wet strokes still moving, a painter's wrist in the picture. Demand wetness and a readable face.
